market_context: Futures indicate a mixed, risk-sensitive open: Nasdaq-100 futures are up roughly 0.4% while S&P 500 futures are up about 0.1% and Dow futures are down approximately 0.2%.[1][3] Semiconductor shares are supported by SK Hynix's strong results, while investors await the 2:00 p.m. ET FOMC decision and after-hours reports from Microsoft and Alphabet.[1][3][6] Elevated event risk makes late-session reversals plausible, particularly with the 10-year yield already at 5.03%.

predictions.reasoning: S&P 500 futures were approximately 0.1% higher before the open, suggesting modest positive breadth despite Dow weakness.[1][3] AI and semiconductor strength should provide some support, but the FOMC decision creates substantial downside and reversal risk.

Nasdaq-100 futures gained about 0.4% as SK Hynix's strong earnings lifted the AI and memory-chip complex.[1][4][6] Nvidia was up roughly 0.8% premarket and AMD about 1.5%, creating a favorable setup for technology-heavy QQQ, although Fed communication may cap gains.[6]

Nvidia was approximately 0.8% higher in premarket trading as SK Hynix reported a more than sevenfold increase in quarterly profit, reinforcing demand expectations across the AI semiconductor supply chain.[6] The stock may retain a bid into the session, but high Treasury yields and the Fed decision limit conviction.

Microsoft reports after the close, so investors may reduce exposure ahead of a high-expectation catalyst rather than chase the premarket technology rally.[1][3] A hawkish Fed decision or guidance could pressure the stock despite strong positioning in the AI trade.

Amazon is exposed to the same elevated-growth valuation sensitivity as other megacap technology shares while investors await major post-close earnings and the FOMC decision.[1][3] With the 10-year yield at 5.03%, modest pre-event profit-taking is more likely than a high-conviction breakout.
